description: Vue.js components for media gallery UI, including list items, card items, and container with media management features.

methods.name: fileSize
methods.description: Calculates size in KB from raw size in bytes.

methods.name: buildMediaUrl
methods.description: Constructs media URL with specified width and height parameters.

methods.name: getfontAwesomeClassNameForFileName
methods.description: Generates Font Awesome class name based on filename.

methods.name: showMediaModal
methods.description: Triggers display of media selection modal.

methods.name: removeDuplicates
methods.description: Removes duplicate media items based on mediaPath.

methods.name: getLocalStorageState
methods.description: Retrieves view state (size, grid/list) from local storage.

methods.name: setLocalStorageState
methods.description: Saves current view state to local storage.

methods.name: initSortable
methods.description: Initializes sortable functionality for media items.

methods.name: selectAndDeleteMedia
methods.description: Emits event to delete selected media.

methods.name: showMediaTextModal
methods.description: Emits event to edit media text.

methods.name: showAnchorModal
methods.description: Emits event to set media anchor.

methods.name: updateSelectedCount
methods.description: Updates count of selected media items.
